tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Check Find a Tender coverage, freshness and remaining free allowance. Free; no data-call allowance consumed.

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search the latest ingested UK Find a Tender notices. Literal AND keywords; region is work location, not buyer address. Three free calls/day per network address, up to 5 notices. After the allowance, or if limit exceeds 5, requires x402 payment (normally 0.01 USDC on Base), up to 25 notices. Empty se

tools.name: get_tender_details
tools.description: Retrieve latest ingested notice by an ocid returned by search_tenders. Uses one of three daily free calls on success; after that requires x402 payment (normally 0.01 USDC on Base). Not a compiled procurement history; description is limited to 6000 characters with an official source link.
